I am writing to formally raise a serious complaint about the disgraceful and unacceptable treatment I received during my visit on 27/08/25.
I arrived just two minutes late for my appointment — only because I had been stood in a queue for five minutes waiting to be checked in. Despite being present and attempting to sign in, my appointment was cancelled without the nurse even calling my name. Instead of any basic understanding, I was then spoken to by your receptionist with an attitude that was cold, dismissive, and completely lacking in basic decency, all in front of a full waiting room.
I was visibly upset and tearful, and yet I was met with zero compassion. As I tried to explain my situation, your receptionist made no attempt to listen or de-escalate. And just to drive the point home, as I walked away in distress, he smirked and said, "You're welcome," in an unmistakably sarcastic tone. That comment was unnecessary, unprofessional, and utterly cruel.
Because I was in such a vulnerable state, my son came down to support me — and he too was appalled at how we were treated. The way both of us were spoken to made us feel like criminals over something as minor as being two minutes late. Your staff's behaviour escalated the situation instead of resolving it. There was no empathy, no professionalism — just arrogance and contempt. It was disgusting.
When I attempted to raise this with the manager on duty, I was met with the same indifference. No one asked if I was okay, despite being visibly distressed. My concerns were clearly dismissed, and my emotional state ignored. The complete lack of care shown by your team was astounding.
I have since read multiple reviews from other patients describing similar experiences with this same receptionist. It's clear this is part of a pattern you’ve chosen to ignore. This is also not the first time I’ve had to complain about your reception staff. On a previous occasion, you acknowledged inappropriate behaviour and issued an apology — which clearly meant nothing, since it’s happened again.
To make matters worse, I also raised the issue of the months of trouble I’ve had trying to make appointments — only to be told by your manager that the information I was repeatedly given by your staff was completely wrong. If that’s true, then your team is either hopelessly untrained or deliberately misleading patients, and your manager either has no control or no integrity.
I expect a formal written response outlining exactly how you are addressing this, and what action is being taken to ensure no other patient is treated in this way. The way I was spoken to, dismissed, and mocked in a healthcare setting is absolutely unforgivable.
